invariants.rationale: The method always puts a value in properties with key 'name', so the map must contain 'name' at method exit.
The put operation assigns a value (castValue) that is never null; 'castProperty' never returns null.
At least one property ('name') was put into the map during this call, so the size must be at least 1.
Map keys are typically required to be non-null for insertion; otherwise, an exception would be expected.
Null 'type' might not be permitted—'castProperty' likely expects a non-null type.
